fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Overview Editor Notes: After meeting requirements of core course, lab courses, practicum and thesis writing, international students will graduate successfully. This program fosters young talent to become superior researchers and engineers engaging in design, manufacturing, R & D and management in the fields of mechanical engineering and its automation, as well as in civil aviation engineering. Systematic study and engineering training help students to gain the following sectors of expertise and capabilities. A solid foundation in fundamental principles and knowledge of Mechanical Engineering and analytical problem-solving skills and design capabilities; Master a broad expertise in mechanical engineering and automation. Mechanical engineers advance the world we live in by constantly improving and inventing technology, not just preserving existing systems. Making our lives easier and everything we use more efficient, mechanical engineers are responsible for some of the most innovative breakthrough designs of our times; such as The London Eye, wind turbines, and surgical robotic technology. 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: The key courses which will be instructed in the 4 years are listed below. Project: Numerical Control Machine Technology Numerical Control Machine Technology Advanced Training of Mechanical Engineering Mechanical Vibration Robotics Die & Mould Technology Multi-media Technology & Applications Computer Integrated Manufacturing Technology Semester 8 Graduation Project 3. Future Career Fields After Graduation? Editor Notes: Graduates are employed in different kinds of fields. Aerospace and Vehicle engineer Automotive engineer Contracting civil engineer Control and instrumentation engineer Nuclear engineer and Hydropower engineer Robotics and Mechanical engineer Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV), Drones engineer Military Service and other related technology-intensive fields 4. Accreditation: Accredited By The Ministry Of Education, China. NUAA's Degree Is Accepted Worldwide Editor Notes: Most students choose to work in the following 13 organizations. NUAA's International Link: NUAA's degree allows you to take your project in China, your home country or a third country. NUAA has partnered with top universities in the USA, Australia, and EU where some students take their third or fourth year of study. Career Prospects: NUAA recent graduates have been employed by organizations such as: 5. Introduction of Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics Editor Notes: World's top 150 Engineering Universities (U.S News Ranking 2018) Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics(NUAA) , established in 1952, enjoys a well-balanced development of multiple disciplines in natural sciences, humanities, social sciences, management, etc. with the characteristics of aeronautics, astronautics and civil aviation. NUAA is among the first batch of national key universities entitled to award doctoral degree, master's degree and bachelor's degree. It is one of the 52 universities with graduate school in China, and it has also been listed in the "National Project 211" as one of the 100 key universities for the 21st century. Presently, NUAA has established international cooperation and exchange with more than 60 universities and institutions all over the world. Learn More>> 6. Colourful Life Editor Notes: More colourful activities are waiting for you to explore. International Cultural Festival Mini-Graduation Ceremony

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. * 2. Non-Criminal letter * 3. Two letters of recommendation from high school teachers, with signature and contact * 4. Financial Guarantee Letter or bank statement * 5. English language proficiency certificate Certificate Letter that English is the learning language during study duration, or English scores in senior high school, or copy of the official IELTS certificate TOFEL certificate. * 6. Photocopy of Foreigner Physical Examination Form You can download a template or sample from here . * 7. Original or notarized copy of transcripts for all the courses in senior high school. Academic Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 8. Personal statement (no more than 800 words), including personal introduction, reasons for application and individual advantages * 9. Resume Written in Chinese or in English * 10. Original or notarized copy of senior high school diploma Certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. Applicants who will graduate can provide pre-graduation certificate instead. The original or notarized diploma shall be submitted upon registration. * 11. Scanned copy of passport front page(and valid China visa page if you are already in China) * 12. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. -CSCA test is mandatory for every application. The test score should be supplemented Before May 30, 2026. Engineering programs: Mathematics and Physics, both in English. Business program: Mathematics, in English. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1.Non-Chinese citizens 2.17-25 years old (Applicants under 18 should provide certificate of guardian who has Nanjing residency.) 3.Senior-high graduates or above 4.English-taught program: IELTS (6.0 or above), TOEFL (80 or above) or equivalent English proficiency letter. 5.CSCA subjects requirements: Engineering programs: Mathematics and Physics, both in English. Business program: Mathematics, in English.
